name: Mutable Instruments modules
author: Emilie Gillet (Mutable Instruments); wrapper by dawlings

provides.title: PLAITS
provides.blurb: Mutable Instruments' macro oscillator: 24 engines from virtual analogue to modal, granular, drums and speech.

provides.title: RINGS
provides.blurb: Mutable Instruments' resonator: strike it with a trigger and hear modal bodies, strings and bells.

provides.title: REVERB
provides.blurb: A lush plate-like reverb from Mutable Instruments' Clouds.

provides.title: CLOUDS
provides.blurb: Mutable Instruments' granular processor: listens to what comes in and plays it back as a cloud of grains.

provides.title: WARPS
provides.blurb: Mutable Instruments' meta-modulator: two signals in, one out, from ring modulation and folding to a vocoder.

provides.title: ELEMENTS
provides.blurb: Mutable Instruments' modal synthesizer: bowed, blown and struck exciters into a resonator, then a reverb.

provides.title: BRAIDS
provides.blurb: Mutable Instruments' macro oscillator: 47 digital and analogue-style shapes, two parameters, a pitch and a trigger.

provides.title: BEADS
provides.blurb: Mutable Instruments' Beads: a granular texture synthesizer that records what comes in and scatters it as grains, or as a pitch-shifting multitap delay.

provides.title: TIDES
provides.blurb: Mutable Instruments' tidal modulator: a gate or clock in, four related slopes out, from an envelope to an LFO to an oscillator.

provides.title: PEAKS
provides.blurb: Mutable Instruments' dual function generator: an envelope, LFO, tap LFO, bouncing ball, mini sequencer, pulse shaper or randomiser, or a bass, snare, hat or FM drum. P1..P4 mean: ENV attack/decay/sustain/release; LFO rate/shape/shape param/phase; TAP LFO level/shape/param/phase; BALL gravity/bounce/height/speed; SEQ the four steps (reset input restarts); SHAPER delay/length/gap/repeats; RANDOM accept/repeat/delay/jitter; BASS pitch/punch/tone/decay; SNARE pitch/tone/snap/decay; HAT none; FM pitch/fm/decay/noise. Drums play on out, the rest on cv.

provides.title: STAGES
provides.blurb: Mutable Instruments' segment generator: a gate runs up to four segments of level, time and shape as an envelope, a looping ramp, a small step sequencer, a timer chain or an LFO.

provides.title: STREAMS
provides.blurb: Mutable Instruments' dual dynamics gate: an envelope, vactrol, follower, compressor or Lorenz generator shaping a signal as a VCA, a low-pass or both.
